class Operator
  hosts() -> HostList
  add_host(expected_revision: str, host: HostEntry) -> HostChange
  remove_host(expected_revision: str, name: str) -> HostChange
  keys() -> KeyList
  issue_key(program: str, credential: str) -> KeyIssued
  revoke_key(program: str) -> KeyRevoked
  audit(cursor: int, max_entries: int) -> AuditPage
  requests(cursor: int, max_entries: int) -> RequestPage
  gateway() -> GatewayState
  set_gateway(expected_revision: str, open: bool, address: str) -> GatewayChange
  program_budgets(credential: str) -> ProgramBudgetPage
  set_program_budget(request: ProgramBudgetChange) -> ProgramBudgetResult

  issue_key(program: str, credential: str) -> KeyIssued
  revoke_key(program: str) -> KeyRevoked
  audit(cursor: int, max_entries: int) -> AuditPage
  requests(cursor: int, max_entries: int) -> RequestPage

  set_gateway(expected_revision: str, open: bool, address: str) -> GatewayChange

  read(target_program: str, name: str) -> SelectionReadV2
  put(target_program: str, expected_revision: str, policy: SelectionPolicyV2) -> SelectionChange
  delete_policy(target_program: str, expected_revision: str, name: str) -> SelectionChange
  read_account_default(name: str) -> SelectionReadV2
  put_account_default(expected_revision: str, policy: SelectionPolicyV2) -> SelectionChange
  delete_account_default(expected_revision: str, name: str) -> SelectionChange
dataclass SelectionPolicyV2
  name: str
  candidates: list[SelectionCandidateV2]

  FOUND = 'found'

  INVALID = 'invalid'
  FORBIDDEN = 'forbidden'
  UNAVAILABLE = 'unavailable'

  PREFERRED_ROUTE_UNAVAILABLE = 'preferred_route_unavailable'
